name: Pemoline

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 2 other countries, first in 1997 — for liver harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave Pemoline a high risk score for liver harm and a low risk score for heart harm [M]. Pemoline was pulled from the market in the United States and two other countries, beginning in 1997, due to liver harm [3]. The drug also carries a boxed warning in the United States [].
